reviews.title: Useless customer service
reviews.text:
I have a magic pass valid until October 2028 which has been confirmed on my PNP account but they are still demanding that I pay if I want access to my son’s videos & games.  I have messaged customer support twice but as I’ve received no response or correction to my account, I feel unable to recommend a company that requires payment for a service that you have already paid for.
Also after years of using this app, standards are slipping, vanishing messages from Santa & after updates on my child’s iPad, it restarts on the adult page allowing my child to see items only meant for adults which has left me with difficult questions to answer & having to log in.  I have checked every setting but this problem persists.  When offering an app aimed at a child, the manufacturer has a responsibility to protect that child’s belief in Santa.

reviews.title: Talk to Santa Feature is obvious AI and Terrible - Do Not Use
reviews.text: The new AI call feature to talk to Santa is a joke. It is advertised as a call from Santa and the audio preview has a child both answering Santa’s questions and asking questions of Santa in a smooth conversation format. You’ll be charged around $8.50 for this and you will quickly wish you had not wasted your money afterwards. Not only is there a significant delay of around 8 seconds between each response from Santa which makes it obvious it is an AI bot, but it will not respond to any questions as advertised regardless of the number of attempts, which will simply make the child upset. I would discourage anyone from wasting any money on it.

reviews.title: Money for nothing
reviews.text:
I’ve been a subscriber for many years but this year I was sent an offer of 50% off, paid, then couldn’t access my account. Kept getting advised by PNP to “contact Apple” or my bank. It’s not their problem - it is this app’s problem. As a customer I shouldn’t have to do all the running when the business has taken my money and then not provided the service I’ve paid for. What it seems to be now is just a scam. 
So I’ve duly reported the PNP payment as fraudulently taken and won’t be using this app - or recommending it to others - again.
